412f33bc: Frieren is an elf. Her lifespan is counted in thousands of years, which completely changes how she perceives time.
ab75c0fc: Who is the hero who defeated the Demon King alongside Frieren?
Himmel, the human hero, led the party made up of Frieren, the priest Heiter and the warrior Eisen.
934e3332: What is Heiter's role in the hero's party?
Heiter is the party's priest, known for his fondness for drink.
45e976b4: Which people does Eisen belong to?
Eisen is a dwarf, the warrior of Himmel's party.
ed28dfb3: Who took in and raised Fern?
Heiter took in Fern, a war orphan, then asked Frieren to teach her magic.
7f0b10f4: Stark was trained by Eisen, who recommends him to Frieren when she sets off north again.
dc95f142: Like his master Eisen, Stark fights with an axe.
b87732d3: Flamme, a great human mage considered the founder of human magic, was Frieren's teacher.
eed59cac: Serie, an elf among the most powerful mages on the continent, trained Flamme. She heads the Continental Magic Association.
b9f2d572: What is the role of Sein, who travels with Frieren for a while?
Sein is a very gifted priest. He eventually leaves the party to search for his childhood friend.
409afff8: Who does Sein go looking for when he leaves the party?
His childhood friend, nicknamed the Gorilla Warrior
Sein sets off on the trail of his childhood friend, a warrior he calls Gorilla.
66488a07: What nickname do demons give Frieren?
Demons call her Frieren the Slayer: no mage has killed as many of them as she has.
7ebea715: Roughly how old is Frieren at the start of the story?
Frieren is more than a thousand years old, which makes the ten-year journey with Himmel a very short period of her life.
677b2494: What gift does Himmel give Frieren?
Himmel gives her a ring with a mirror lotus design, which Frieren chose herself.
9b262652: What does the mirror lotus on the ring Himmel gave her symbolize?
The mirror lotus symbolizes eternal love, a meaning Frieren did not know when she chose the ring.
6a73efe6: Why does Himmel have statues of himself erected wherever he goes?
So that Frieren won't be alone in the future
Himmel explains that he wants to leave traces so that Frieren, who will outlive him by centuries, won't be alone.
7e6d1726: Why does Eisen refuse to travel with Frieren again?
He is at war with the elves
He says he is too old
Eisen feels he has become too old for such a journey, and recommends his student Stark to her.
6830d6c8: What quality is Fern noted for in combat?
Fern casts ordinary offensive magic with rare speed and conceals her mana as well as Frieren does.
77307781: What is the offensive spell created by the demon Qual called?
Zoltraak was known as “the magic that kills people” before humans studied it.
4e53c372: What does Zoltraak become while Qual is sealed away?
While Qual was sealed, humans analyzed Zoltraak so thoroughly that it became the basis of offensive magic.
8fecf49a: How long did Frieren keep Qual sealed?
Qual was sealed for about 80 years. When he woke up, his once-feared spell had become commonplace.
21da53fd: What did mages develop to counter Zoltraak?
Defensive magic, which creates barriers, was perfected in response to Zoltraak.
b15e5bfe: How does Frieren deceive demons about her true power?
On Flamme's advice, Frieren has been concealing her mana at all times for over a thousand years.
b13f7baf: What kind of spells does Frieren like to collect?
Frieren collects everyday spells, like removing rust from a statue or making a field of flowers bloom.
24f66172: A spell that makes a field of flowers appear
Flamme loved the spell that makes a field of flowers bloom, which Frieren uses in turn.
29e3b6b2: Which trap does Frieren regularly fall for?
Frieren opens mimic chests hoping to find a grimoire inside, and every time ends up with her head stuck in them.
17daec31: Which exam do Frieren and Fern take to get an official rank?
The First-Class Mage Exam takes up a large part of the end of the first season.
a0bea103: Does Fern pass the First-Class Mage Exam?
9217124d: Who fails Frieren in the final stage of the exam?
Serie conducts the final stage herself and fails Frieren.
ce6f2735: Which spell does Fern choose as her reward after the exam?
A spell that removes stains from clothes
Fern chooses a very practical spell for removing stains from clothes, a choice that surprises Serie.
71413728: What is the nickname of Aura, one of the Seven Sages of Destruction?
Aura the Guillotine is one of the Seven Sages of Destruction who served the Demon King.
05d3a0ef: How many Sages of Destruction served the Demon King?
There were seven, hence the name Seven Sages of Destruction.
5d6a5701: What is Aura's magic item called?
The Scales of Obedience compare the two opponents' mana: the weaker one becomes the stronger one's puppet.
ae64f13e: Why does Aura lose to Frieren?
Frieren had hidden her true amount of mana
Aura judged Frieren by her visible mana. Once the scales are activated, Frieren's real mana wins out.
c2846ec8: What order does Frieren give Aura after defeating her?
“Aura, kill yourself”: the scene has become one of the most famous in the anime.
6f5e82c5: According to Frieren, why do demons speak human language?
For Frieren, demons imitate human speech to deceive, without sharing the feelings it expresses.
48c1db07: Which people does Qual belong to?
Qual is a demon, creator of Zoltraak, sealed by Frieren for decades.
e48894c9: Which of these characters serves Aura?
Lügner is one of Aura's subordinates. Übel, Denken and Wirbel are human mages met during the exam.
0ea5a530: How long did Himmel's party take to defeat the Demon King?
The journey lasted ten years, a tiny span on the scale of Frieren's life.
f7515602: Which phenomenon does the party watch at the end of the journey, and again 50 years later?
The Era Meteor Shower returns every 50 years. Frieren promises to see it again with her companions.
11c7b56a: What happens to Himmel at the start of the series?
He is killed by a demon
Himmel dies of old age shortly after seeing the meteor shower again with Frieren.
d060e155: What does Frieren regret at Himmel's funeral?
Not defeating the Demon King alone
Not getting to know him better
Frieren weeps as she realizes she barely knew Himmel. It is the starting point of her new journey.
c00e20f5: Where does Frieren want to go to speak with Himmel again?
Aureole, the land where the souls of the dead are said to rest, lies in the far north, in Ende.
01f7b744: In which direction does Frieren's party travel?
Frieren, Fern and Stark head north, toward Ende.
82d895f0: Why did Himmel never own the true hero's sword?
It broke against the Demon King
He could not pull it from its pedestal
Himmel could not pull out the legendary sword. Yet he defeated the Demon King with a mere replica.

Frieren runs in Shogakukan's Weekly Shōnen Sunday.

f340e27a: How many episodes does the anime's first season have?
